reference_variant_gate: Only traceable official LIDAR_TOP calibration and physical alignment sufficient for exact upright box mapping; otherwise NotRun. No chosen height/yaw without evidence.
annotation_sampling: Train/Val only: first2core empty per split, firstframe per class x [0,10)/[10,20)/[20,40)m, firstcamera-supported frame per6 cameras, first multiActor; deduplicate. Background: top3 unmatched score>=0.1 per coarse class perselected frame, cap12/frame; no population extrapolation.

identity_rule.proposal: Existing M8B score>=0.1 one-to-one projection association, unchanged
identity_rule.IdentitySupported: GT unique render association purity>=0.9 plus >=8 retained maskpixels; projected rectangle vs tight instancebbox IoU>=0.5 and maskrecall>=0.8, competitor identity bbox IoU<0.1 in each supporting view. At least2 agreeing views AND no contradictory view. Automated evidence-supported, not human certified. No 3Derror used.
identity_rule.ProjectionProxyOnly: Original projection pair without sufficient multi-view identity evidence
identity_rule.AmbiguousAssociation: Competitor identity support in same view, or inconsistent identity across views
identity_rule.NoSupportedAssociation: No original one-to-one pair at declared score

human_review: Assistant visual inspection explicitly identified, not certified human annotation. No silent upgrades from screenshots.
geometry_hooks: Trace actual locals at official position_embeding return, copy input norms/masks and hook position_encoder input, head all900 queries/all6 layers. Hook on/off output equality plus overhead on firstsample; no network changes.
background_rules: Same rendered target support is image evidence only. Static semantic region may support class but not 3Didentity. Missing coverage => AmbiguousOrUnlabeled. DuplicateHypothesis requires same box or near-identical projected hypothesis; UnsupportedClass recorded taxonomy gap not model inability.
ablation_RGB_preprocessing: Identical frozen official M8B; no augmentation search
